bio.text: Russ Huxtable has represented Delaware Senate District 6, which includes Milton, Lewes, Rehoboth Beach and Dewey Beach, since 2022.
According to his official page, Huxtable graduated from Mount Pleasant High School and holds a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Delaware (1995).
The page says he spent two decades with nonprofits focused on affordable housing, most recently as vice president of the Milford Housing Development Corp., and lives outside Lewes.
